shift.description: int or tuple of ints The number of places by which elements are shifted. If a tuple, then `axis` must be a tuple of the same size, and each of the given axes is shifted by the corresponding number. If an int while `axis` is a tuple of ints, then the same value is used for all given axes.

axis.description: int or tuple of ints, optional Axis or axes along which elements are shifted. By default, the array is flattened before shifting, after which the original shape is restored.

output.description: ------- ndarray Output array, with the same shape as `a`.
